Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring voter approval of certain city assumptions of water-sewer districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to city assumption of watersewer districts; andadding a new section to chapter 35.13A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city may not assume, under this chapter, the jurisdiction of allor part of a watersewer district serving a population greater thanfive thousand residents and containing, within its boundaries, theterritory of two or more cities, or one city and unincorporatedterritory, unless voters of the entire watersewer district approve aballot proposition authorizing the assumption under general electionlaw. The cost of the election shall be borne by the city seekingapproval to assume jurisdiction of a watersewer district.
